examples.japanese: {背筋|せすじ}を{伸|の}ばして、きちんと{座|すわ}ってください。
examples.english: Straighten your back and sit properly.

examples.japanese: {能力|のうりょく}を{伸|の}ばす。
{子供|こども}の{才能|さいのう}を{伸|の}ばすために、いろいろな{経験|けいけん}をさせたい。
examples.english: I want to give my child various experiences to develop their talents.

notes:
{伸|の}ばす means to stretch, extend, or grow something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {伸|の}びる (intransitive - to stretch, grow)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手|て}を{伸|の}ばす: to reach out one's hand
- {髪|かみ}を{伸|の}ばす: to grow out one's hair
- {背筋|せすじ}を{伸|の}ばす: to straighten one's back
- {能力|のうりょく}を{伸|の}ばす: to develop one's abilities
- {記録|きろく}を{伸|の}ばす: to extend a record

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {伸|の}ばす: to stretch physically, to develop
- {延|の}ばす: to extend, postpone (time, deadlines)
